name: Kitzbüheler Horn
kurzbeschreibung: The Kitzbüheler Horn at 1,996 m offers 360-degree panoramic views, cable cars, the Alpenblumengarten, and Austria's steepest panoramic road.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Kitzbüheler Horn is a prominent, 1,996-metre-high mountain peak in the Kitzbüheler Alpen and forms the widely visible northeastern landmark of Kitzbühel. With its striking 102-metre-high red-and-white ORF transmission tower on the summit plateau, the mountain stands out unmistakably against the surrounding alpine landscape. As a multifaceted scenic and adventure mountain, the Horn reveals a breathtaking 360-degree panorama stretching from the majestic Wilder Kaiser in the north across the Loferer Steinberge to the ice-clad three-thousanders of the Hohe Tauern in the south.

Attractions, Botany & Sporting History

Tourism development began in the 1950s with the construction of cable cars by Bergbahn AG KitzSki. The modern Hornbahn carries passengers in two sections from Kitzbühel via the middle station to the Alpenhaus (1,670 m) and onward via the summit aerial tramway directly to the top station at just under 2,000 metres. A primary botanical attraction just below the peak at 1,880 metres is the Alpenblumengarten Kitzbüheler Horn: across more than 20,000 m² of alpine pasture and rock terrain grow over 300 rare high-mountain plants from the Alps, the Caucasus, the Andes, and the Himalayas (admission free!). For athletic cyclists and motorists, the toll road Kitzbüheler Horn Panoramastraße leads from Kitzbühel up 7.5 kilometres of steep serpentines to the Alpenhaus. With maximum gradients of up to 22.3 percent, the route is considered the steepest paved cycling mountain in Austria and achieved global cult status as the legendary queen stage of the Tour of Austria (Internationale Österreich-Rundfahrt).

Visit & Getting There

The Hornbahn lifts operated by Bergbahn AG KitzSki run daily during the summer season from late May to late October from 08:30 to 17:00 (in winter the Horn offers an extensive ski resort). Summer 2025/2026 tariffs (round trip to the Horn summit): adults €35.00 (with guest card €33.00), youths approx. €19.50, children (born 2011–2020) €12.50, toddlers free. Cable car travel is free with the Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card. Panoramic road toll: cars approx. €12.00. Rail travel: ÖBB to Kitzbühel Hahnenkamm or Kitzbühel Hauptbahnhof station, from there free city bus directly to the Hornbahn valley station. By car: via the B161 to Kitzbühel, large free cable car parking available at the Hornbahn valley station.

Tips

The cable car up to the Alpenhaus is barrier-free accessible; the summit path and the Alpenblumengarten run through natural rocky terrain, requiring sturdy footwear and surefootedness. Highly rewarding is the scenic circular hike along the Karstweg or a relaxing stop on the sun terrace of the traditional Gipfelhaus mountain lodge.
preis: Berg- und Talfahrt bis Gipfel Erwachsene 35,00 €, Kinder 12,50 €
oeffnungszeiten: Ende Mai bis Ende Okt täglich 08:30–17:00 Uhr (Winter Dez–Apr)
